steps.label: NON-VOLATILE
steps.sub: appended, never updated or deleted in place

code:
SELECT d.CalendarYear, d.EnglishMonthName,
       SUM(f.SalesAmount) AS MonthlySales
FROM dbo.FactInternetSales AS f
JOIN dbo.DimDate AS d ON d.DateKey = f.OrderDateKey
WHERE d.CalendarYear = 2011
GROUP BY d.CalendarYear, d.EnglishMonthName, d.MonthNumberOfYear;
caption: 2011's numbers never change — nobody edits history the way an OLTP row gets corrected.
